_about: Hand corrections for event listings (src/pipeline.js). Each rule matches by source id and a title regex (case-insensitive). "set" fills listing fields before geocoding (e.g. a missing venue); "add_interests" adds interest tags after the classifier, "only_interests" replaces them (known ids only: books, art, nature, science, trains, play).

rules._why: Vancouver's Downtown Association lists Columbia Springs' nature days with no venue; they're at Columbia Springs in east Vancouver, not downtown (Nov 2026).
rules.title: Columbia Springs

rules._why: The city's listing has no description or place, and its link (/recreation/tualatin-light-parades) is a dead page from the old site (checked Nov 2026). Facts from the city's past parade pages and local press; check the routes each December.
rules.title: ^Tualatin Light Parades$

set.description: Lit-up floats, trucks and cars wind through a different part of Tualatin each night to kick off the holidays. Parades start at 6pm and take about 1½-2 hours; watch from the curb along the route. Free. Routes and a live tracker are posted on the City of Tualatin website.

rules.title: ^Storytime On Location$
